title: ROG: A Multi-Layer Manually Annotated Corpus of Spoken Slovenian
manual_evidence: Paper states manually annotated prosodic units/disfluencies/dialogue acts on about half of 75k-word/10h corpus
nonqualifying_layer: morphosyntax/dialogue annotation alone is outside phonetic-production core
reason: Potentially qualifying manual prosodic production layer, but it builds on pre-existing SST/GOS2 recordings; must establish whether the new manual prosodic layer is isolatable and whether underlying recordings satisfy lineage criterion.
next_action: Locate repository; enumerate annotation/audio; isolate newly contributed prosodic annotations and establish recording lineage before acceptance.
